title: AI Engineering Capstone — Choose One Complete, Small Product
key_insight: Choose one user job and a small end-to-end slice with real inputs, a useful output, and a visible fallback.
body:
## Choose One Complete, Small Product

A capstone tries to train a frontier model, serve millions, and solve five user problems. Its scope prevents any route from becoming complete.

Choose one user job and a small end-to-end slice with real inputs, a useful output, and a visible fallback.

Write acceptance criteria before building. A modest deployed workflow with evidence teaches more than an unfinished grand design.
common_mistakes: The largest possible scope makes the strongest capstone.
A happy-path demo proves production readiness.
Code alone explains every design tradeoff.
mini_exercise: Draw “Choose One Complete, Small Product” as three labeled steps, then explain the decision at each step.
real_world_usage: A complete artifact demonstrates integration across data, models, product decisions, safety, and reliable delivery.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Choose One Complete, Small Product,” explain AI Engineering Capstone without assuming the listener knows AI engineering.
